
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:5[/yellow bold]

GPIO 5: GPIO 5 is a strapping pin. Outputs PWM signal during boot. Connected loads (relays, motors) may briefly activate.

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led = 2
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin motor: PWM = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

GPIO 36 has a hardware errata: interrupts may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep. Use a different pin for interrupt-driven input.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin motor: PWM = 5
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin battery: Analog = 36
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: GPIO 34, 35 do not have this errata.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- STATE MACHINE WARNING -- main.volt:41[/yellow bold]

State `low_power` in machine `power_manager` is unreachable from initial state `normal`.

 [dim]40 |[/dim] 
 [dim]41 |[/dim]     state low_power {
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]          ^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]
